The Ultimate TV Remote & Smart TV Control

Tired of juggling multiple remotes? Lost your Smart TV remote again? Upgrade your streaming experience with Smart TV, the most intuitive and feature-rich Smart TV remote app for your iPhone or iPad. Smart TV is the all-in-one solution for controlling your entire smart TV ecosystem — whether it's a standard Smart TV, Your TV, or any other connected device.

Its sleek, user-friendly interface puts all your favorite features at your fingertips, making navigation a breeze whether you're streaming on Your TV, adjusting settings, or browsing apps. Whether you're using it as a Smart TV remote control, a TV channel manager, or a smart remote for screen mirroring — this app has you covered.

Key Features

- Universal Smart TV Remote: Control virtually any Smart TV from your iPhone or iPad. This remote app works with a wide range of Smart TV models.
- Quick Search: Find your favorite shows and movies faster with integrated voice search and virtual keyboard. Simply speak or type your query to search across your TV channels.
- Smart TV Screen Mirroring: Stream photos, videos, and music from your phone or tablet directly to Your TV. Enjoy your content on the big screen with seamless screen mirroring.
- Smart TV Channel Manager: Easily manage channels. Add new ones, switch between them, and launch favorites like Netflix, Hulu, or HBO Max with a single tap.
- Automatic Device Detection: Smart TV remote app auto-detects compatible devices on your WiFi network, making setup simple and fast.

Advanced Remote Control Features

- Intuitive Touchpad and Keyboard: Navigate your Smart TV effortlessly with a responsive touchpad and easy-to-use keyboard.
- Favorite Channels: Save your most-watched TV channels for quick access.
- Voice Search: Use voice commands to search across all available content and channels.
- Convenient Widget: Access essential controls directly from your home screen with the included widget.

Works with All TVs: This remote app is compatible with most Smart TV brands, making it a truly universal solution.
This Smart TV remote app is designed to work seamlessly with a wide range of television models and streaming devices, offering a universal solution for all your remote control needs — all without the clutter of multiple remotes.

Subscription Information
Our app offers a premium subscription plan for advanced features. The subscription is priced at $6.99 per week. Payment will be charged to your iTunes account upon confirmation of purchase.
Auto-renewal: Your subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Manage subscriptions: Subscriptions can be managed, and auto-renewal can be disabled in your account settings.
Free trial: If a free trial is offered, any unused portion will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

Enjoy uninterrupted access to all premium features by subscribing today!

Disclaimer: This app is not affiliated with or endorsed by any specific TV brands.
